LANDING.HEADER: Welcome to the FFXIV Completionist App!

NAV_DRAWER.TITLE: Navigation Drawer (that thingy on the left)
NAV_DRAWER.L1: This UI shows all top level groups at all times as well as the home menu (FFXIV Completionist)
NAV_DRAWER.L2: Clicking one of these groups expands its sub groups while the previously selected group's retracts

CRUMBS.TITLE: Breadcrumbs (that chain of groups just below the overall completion metric)
CRUMBS.L1: Clicking one of these navigates back up to that earlier parent group

NAV_HISTORY.TITLE: Navigation History (the button to the left of the breadcrumbs)
NAV_HISTORY.L1: Several previously opened groups are cached in this menu
NAV_HISTORY.L2: Clicking on one of these navigates to that group

COMPLETION.TITLE: Completion Bars (those pretty bars that show up when a group is selected)
COMPLETION.L1: When any group that shows completion bars is selected, you can click on those bars to dive down instead of using the nav drawer

SEARCH.TITLE: Search
SEARCH.L1: The Search input in the top-left of the page enables searching the entire app for a term
SEARCH.L2: After entering the term hit Enter or click the search button to run the search
SEARCH.L3: Clicking on a group in the results takes you directly to that group
SEARCH.L4: The search input can be focused by hitting Ctrl+F or Cmd+F

SHOW_ALL.TITLE: Show All Tasks
SHOW_ALL.L1: Groups that have sub groups with similar data have a "Show All Tasks" button
SHOW_ALL.L2: Activating this gives a table with all tasks from each sub group
SHOW_ALL.L3: An additional column is added indicating which sub group the task comes from
SHOW_ALL.L4: Clicking the link in this column navigates to that sub group
SHOW_ALL.L5: When showing all tasks, the button becomes "Exit All Task View" which deactivates the table

CELL_LINK.TITLE: Cell Links
CELL_LINK.L1: Some cells may have one or multiple links to other content
CELL_LINK.L2: Clicking on one of these links navigates to that content
CELL_LINK.L3: If the link is inside a tooltip, click on the value in the cell first

PERSIST.TITLE: Persistence
PERSIST.L1: The currently selected group is saved when closing the app

SORTING.TITLE: Sorting
SORTING.L1: Columns can be sorted by clicking the column title
SORTING.L2: The icons in the column headers indicate the currently active sort
SORTING.L3: Multiple columns can be sorted using the Ctrl key when clicking a title

FILTER_COMPLETION.TITLE: Filter Completion
FILTER_COMPLETION.L1: At the top of completion columns are 3 icons that indicate "completed", "not completed", and "excluded"
FILTER_COMPLETION.L2: These can be enabled/disabled separately and their state is saved between tables and reloads
FILTER_COMPLETION.L3: Items in the table that match any enabled icon will be displayed

FILTER_COLUMN.TITLE: Filter Columns
FILTER_COLUMN.L1: At the top of each column is a text input to filter tasks in that table
FILTER_COLUMN.L2: This input may have a dropdown if the column has few unique values
FILTER_COLUMN.L3: This filter is case-insensitive and matches anywhere within that column
FILTER_COLUMN.L4: Entering "Blank" will filter for tasks without a value in that column

SELECT.TITLE: Select Items
SELECT.L1: Clicking on any row will "select" it and turn it a different color
SELECT.L2: The "Quick-Mark" and "Selection Actions" overlays contain actions for selected tasks
SELECT.L3: In Crafting Log groups this menu contains an option to export all selected recipes to external sites

ROW_ACTION.TITLE: Row Actions
ROW_ACTION.L1: The last column in every row has a "Row Action" menu
ROW_ACTION.L2: Some actions attempt to export the task to external sites
ROW_ACTION.L3: NOTE: Some tasks may not open properly on external sites

VIRTUAL.TITLE: Virtual Scrolling
VIRTUAL.L1: In order to accomodate quick rendering of particularly large groups, all tables implement "virtual scrolling"
VIRTUAL.L2: As tables are scrolled, their header may jitter, this is a product of that feature

BOOKMARKS.TITLE: Bookmarks
BOOKMARKS.L1: Individual tasks can be added or removed from bookmarks through the row action menu
BOOKMARKS.L2: Groups can be added or removed as well through the "Table Settings" overlay
BOOKMARKS.L3: Bookmarked tasks are counted toward completion of the Bookmarks group
BOOKMARKS.L4: Bookmarked groups are not counted toward completion of the Bookmarks group
BOOKMARKS.L5: Bookmarked items are not duplicated in the Overall percentage

CUSTOM_TASKS.TITLE: Custom Tasks
CUSTOM_TASKS.L1: Tasks can be manually added in this group along with custom notes
CUSTOM_TASKS.L2: Custom tasks can be edited by selecting them
CUSTOM_TASKS.L3: Custom tasks can be reordered through the row action menu
CUSTOM_TASKS.L4: Custom tasks also have the ability to merge into the app, allowing for easier updates after patches

MERGING.TITLE: Notes about merging:
MERGING.L1: Merge searches are case-insensitive and ignores anything that isn't a letter or number
MERGING.L2: Merge searches look for the whole name of the task, partials will not be displayed
MERGING.L3: Upon clicking one of the matches for merge, that Custom Task will be removed along with its notes
MERGING.L4: All tasks with a single match can be auto-merged without needing to confirm each one

MARKING.TITLE: Marking Completion
MARKING.L1: When navigated to a group that has tasks there will be a table
MARKING.L2: On the left of that table is the completion column
MARKING.L3: Left Click: Toggles the task's completion
MARKING.L4: Right Click: Mark the task as "X"

NUMERIC.TITLE: Numeric Completion
NUMERIC.L1: Some groups have completion based on a number range
NUMERIC.L2: In these tables the completion column will instead contain an numeric input field
NUMERIC.L3: These fields validate data entered into them, so data entered may be changed to fit within the range
NUMERIC.L4: These fields only commit the data entered after clicking away from them
NUMERIC.L5: The arrows next to the field may also be used to change the value by a single step

QUICK_MARK.TITLE: Quick-Mark Overlay
QUICK_MARK.L1: Above the table is an overlay menu that has several options for altering completion state of many tasks at once
QUICK_MARK.L2: Only visible tasks will be modified by the actions in this menu

CALCULATIONS.TITLE: Calculations
CALCULATIONS.L1: Tasks marked as "X" are excluded from completion percentages
CALCULATIONS.L2: Numeric completion tasks are counted as their value minus their base value
CALCULATIONS.L3: i.e. Reaper starts at 70, so will only count as 10 points if set to 80
CALCULATIONS.L4: Tasks are not weighted so completing an ultimate nets the same progress as crafting an Oak Lumber
CALCULATIONS.L5: Custom tasks are counted toward overall completion

STATISTICS.TITLE: Statistics
STATISTICS.L1: Hovering over the progress bar for any group gives you a tooltip detailing that group's completion stats

SAVING.TITLE: Saving
SAVING.L1: Completion is saved as soon as tasks are marked
SAVING.L2: Completion is migrated between versions of the app
SAVING.L3: Sometimes Patch Notes will indicate tasks that need to be manually reviewed

OVERVIEW.TITLE: Overview
OVERVIEW.L1: "Chaining" is the term used for when the app auto-marks a related task to the one just marked
OVERVIEW.L11: Tasks are chained backwards if the marked task could not have been completed without the previous
OVERVIEW.L12: Tasks are chained together if it is not possible to have one without the other
OVERVIEW.L13: Tasks can chain to exclude another task if they are mutually exclusive
OVERVIEW.L14: Tasks can be chained if each required task is completed
OVERVIEW.L15: Numeric tasks can be chained in the same way normal tasks can
OVERVIEW.L2: Chaining can be disabled in the settings page

SPECIFICS.TITLE: Specifics
SPECIFICS.L1: Items that must be used after acquiring them from another task are not chained
SPECIFICS.L2: Tasks that require "X" amount of some thing may not be chained if:
SPECIFICS.L21: X is something other than 1, all, or a contiguous range
SPECIFICS.L22: That thing is not a numeric completion task

INTERFACE.TITLE: Interface
INTERFACE.L1: Any page with a table will have the chain overlay available
INTERFACE.L2: The overlay button will pulse if the most recently marked task chained to other tasks
INTERFACE.L3: Affected groups can be navigated to using this overlay
INTERFACE.L4: An undo is available for the most recently chained events
INTERFACE.L5: NOTE: Undo is not available for chains from custom tasks or setting starting class

SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.L1: Enable/Disable: Allows you to turn chaining on or off completely
SETTINGS.L2: History Limit: The amount of chained events to keep in memory to undo
SETTINGS.L3: Min Threshold: Sets the number of chained tasks allowed before collapsing groups within the chain overlay
SETTINGS.L4: NOTE: Setting the history limit too high may cause memory issues

OVERVIEW.TITLE: Overview
OVERVIEW.L1: The app creates a save with a default name in a default location
OVERVIEW.L2: The currently active save can be viewed in the settings page
OVERVIEW.L3: The app relies on 2+ files to handle save data
OVERVIEW.L31: "config.json": Holds configuration data for the app itself
OVERVIEW.L32: "completion.json": Holds save data for characters, can be renamed to anything
OVERVIEW.L4: NOTE: Modifying these files manually may lead to unexpected issues, especially with the app open
OVERVIEW.L5: The following actions can be found in Character Settings

CHANGE.TITLE: Change Save
CHANGE.L1: "Create New" creates an additional new save and makes it the active save
CHANGE.L2: "Load Existing" changes the active save to the chosen save

OPEN.TITLE: Open Folder
OPEN.L1: Opens the folders containing the active config and/or save

BACKUP.TITLE: Backup
BACKUP.L1: Creates a backup of the active config and/or save
BACKUP.L2: I recommended doing this before updating to a new version of the app
BACKUP.L3: May be unnecessary for the save file if it is located in a directory that is automatically cloud saved with history

LOAD_BACKUP.TITLE: Load Backup
LOAD_BACKUP.L1: OVERWRITES the currently active config or save with a backup

RELEASE.TITLE: Releases
RELEASE.L2: Each release comes with Patch Notes

LOCALIZATION.TITLE: Localization
LOCALIZATION.L1: Current language can be set within the settings page
LOCALIZATION.L3: German and Japanese localization is a possiblity with volunteers
LOCALIZATION.L4: Additional localization is possible with volunteers and more effort

FEEDBACK.TITLE: Feedback
FEEDBACK.L1: Any feedback for the app can be communicated through discord here:

FINAL.L1: Thats it! Go forth and complete! :D
